name: Kitten Forest
lore: Past the Goblin King's throne the road runs on into a lantern-lit wood of giant toadstools, where kittens nap, play and make mischief in every glade.
sourceNote: FLUX.1 [schnell] by Black Forest Labs (Apache-2.0), 4-bit GGUF, run on the studio's Mac; 103 candidates, 50 picks and 27 spares (game-research/sappers-path-v4/lands/01-kitten-forest/README.md). Each picture's file is the subject-cropped 160 px source with its fixed chroma (that README's hand-off warning), so convert gives back exactly the boards the picks were judged on.

profile.note: Land 1 after its critics (tools/land-01-notes.md §10, the fix pass): genuinely harder than 151-200 for a player who plans (the functional critic M1: the careful player, 3 taps ahead, won Land 1 more often than 151-200). Tags E4/N14/H18/X14 in a sawtooth of five runs ending Extreme at 250, each run split by a Normal dip (landTags: runs of 2-5). Features: ? cards on every Normal, Hard and Extreme level (3-6, in tray rows 1-3), linked squads on 10 of 14 Normals, 15 of 18 Hards and every Extreme (1-3 pairs: 3-4 kept Hard levels out of their random-tap band in a trial), mystery blocks on the other 4 Normals, 11 Hards and every Extreme (of 0.36-0.60 of the eligible blocks off the subject's face: about 20-35% of the picture), a lock on every Hard and Extreme: every Normal carries 2 features, Hard 3-4, Extreme 4 (all Land 1 has; moats arrive at Land 2). Random-tap bands as before (Normal 1-7%, Hard and Extreme 0-1%), one-move lookahead ceilings as before (0.30, 0.15, 0.10), and new careful-player ceilings (16 games, 3 taps ahead; the bake narrows toward 0.6 of them and leans the pick under them, careWeight): Normal 0.5, Hard 0.375, Extreme 0.3125 (151-200 measured 0.71, 0.46, 0.58). bake: 12 candidates a Normal, 14 a Hard or Extreme, half of them dealt deeper (deepAlt). Pace aim 200 s. The 50 pictures: 45 of the first bake plus 5 spares (kf82, kf77, kf13, kf41, kf16) in place of 227, 236, 237, 247 and 249 (near-repeats and weak reads), laid out for variety (no neighbours sharing a category, ground or coat; no orange cat within two of another; near-repeat ideas 10+ levels apart; the few-colour boards on the Easy breathers).
